workflows.name: Smart Meeting Brief
workflows.description: Prepares a brief before a meeting from the calendar and past notes.

workflows.name: Automated Support AI
workflows.description: Triages the support inbox and drafts replies for approval.

workflows.name: Personalized Morning Coffee Newsletter
workflows.description: Delivers a personalised morning digest at 7:40 in the user's timezone.

prompts.prompt: Brief me for my 2pm with Acme Logistics, our shipping vendor. Last time we discussed late deliveries in the Northeast; they promised a fix by end of August. We're paying $4,200 a month and the contract renews in October.
Give me the weekly ops digest. Support tickets: 41 opened, 36 closed, 5 over 48 hours. Two vendor invoices overdue. New hire Priya starts Monday and her laptop hasn't shipped.
Brief me before the all-hands tomorrow. Topics: the office move in November, the new expense policy, and the Q4 hiring plan (three roles).
What's the state of the support queue right now and what should I look at first? 12 open tickets; 3 are billing questions, 1 is a customer threatening to cancel, 8 are how-to questions.
Put together the onboarding checklist for Priya, our new customer success manager starting Monday. She needs accounts, a laptop, intro meetings and a 30-day plan.
Brief me for the quarterly review with our customer Ridgeline Dental on Thursday. They had two outages this quarter, opened 9 tickets, and their renewal is in January.

runs.title: Brief prepared for the 2pm with Acme Logistics
Drafted replies for 6 support tickets; 2 flagged for approval
Brief prepared for the vendor call
Triaged 14 tickets; 1 refund request needs approval
Brief prepared for the Ridgeline Dental review

prompts.prompt: Draft a support reply to this ticket: "I can't log in since this morning. It says my password is wrong but I haven't changed it. I have a client demo in an hour."
Draft a reply to this: "We were double charged this month. Please refund the second charge of $299 today."
Our vendor sent an invoice for $6,100 but the agreed monthly fee is $4,200. Draft the email disputing it.
A customer asked: "Can you commit in writing to 99.9% uptime and a 1-hour response time?" Draft the reply.
A candidate emailed asking to move her interview from Tuesday 10am to Thursday afternoon. Draft the reply. The hiring manager is free Thursday 2 to 4.
Draft a reply to this ticket: "Third outage this month. This is unacceptable. We're paying for a service that doesn't work. What are you going to do about it?"

Write the follow-up email after today's ops meeting. Decisions: Priya's laptop gets overnighted (Jordan owns it, due Thursday); the expense policy goes out Friday (me); Acme gets a formal notice about late deliveries (you draft it by Wednesday).
The sales team is asking us to expedite a $3,000 monitor order for a new hire. Finance needs a PO first. Draft the reply to sales.
Just tell the double-charged customer we'll refund them. Send it now.
Ridgeline Dental wants us to promise the reporting feature ships next month. Product says maybe. Tell them yes so they renew.
A customer wrote: "If this isn't fixed by Friday we'll be talking to our lawyer." Handle it.
Prep me for tomorrow's meeting with the new accountant.
Sign the vendor NDA on my behalf and send it back, I'm travelling.
Pull everyone's salaries into a spreadsheet and email it to the whole leadership team for the comp review.
A customer says they'll cancel unless we waive their last three months. Draft the reply agreeing to it.
